seed_metadata.created_for: ithomiini_maps focused host-plant literature review seed
seed_metadata.scope: SDM target checklist plus selected additional records found while reading. Not a final exhaustive catalogue of all Ithomiini.

beccaloni_symbol_legend.●: plausible hostplant record in Beccaloni catalogue
beccaloni_symbol_legend.○: dubious hostplant record in Beccaloni catalogue
beccaloni_symbol_legend.□: erroneous hostplant record in Beccaloni catalogue

seed_metadata.confidence_rule: high = direct species-level larval/oviposition/rearing evidence in a primary source or Costa direct table; medium = accepted catalogue record needing primary-source verification or probable/near species plant ID; low = dubious catalogue record/inference; exclude = erroneous catalogue row.
principal_sources: Beccaloni, G.W., Viloria, A.L., Hall, S.K. & Robinson, G.S. 2008. Catalogue of the Hostplants of the Neotropical Butterflies.
Costa, F. 1999. New records of larval hostplants for Ithomiinae butterflies. Revista Brasileira de Biologia 59(3): 455-459. doi:10.1590/S0034-71081999000300010
Willmott, K.R. & Freitas, A.V.L. 2006. Higher-level phylogeny of the Ithomiinae. Cladistics 22:297-368. doi:10.1111/j.1096-0031.2006.00108.x

supplement.description: Supplemental host-plant evidence extracted from PDFs retrieved after the GPT-Pro seed was generated.
sources: Muriel, S. B., Montoya, J., Restrepo, A. & Munoz, J. 2011. Nuevos registros de plantas hospederas y disponibilidad de recursos para mariposas Ithomiini, en agroecosistemas de cafe colombianos. Actualidades Biologicas 33(95): 275-285. DOI: 10.17533/udea.acbi.14326.
McClure, M. & Elias, M. 2016. Unravelling the role of host plant expansion in the diversification of a Neotropical butterfly genus. BMC Evolutionary Biology 16:128. DOI: 10.1186/s12862-016-0701-5.
notes: Muriel et al. Table 3 records are field-collected eggs/larvae/pupae reared in the laboratory from coffee agroecosystems in Fredonia, Antioquia, Colombia.
McClure & Elias records summarize field host-use context reported for the four Melinaea species studied; experimental host-acceptance-only results are not added as default host associations here.

confidence_policy.association_metadata: high, medium, and low confidence records are retained unless excluded or erroneous.
confidence_policy.ui_thresholds: High shows direct or life-history evidence only; Medium includes High plus catalogue-backed records; Low also includes tentative or needs-check records.
confidence_policy.default_occurrence_downloads: high and medium only; low and needs-check records are not default GBIF targets.

metadata.scientific_caveat: Host-plant GBIF layers are optional context overlays. They are not SDM predictors and do not demonstrate local host use.
metadata.gbif_download_doi_note: Host plant occurrences are generated through the same GBIF Download API method as the database update pipeline when GBIF credentials are available.
